title: Asher's Inheritance
description: The fifth lot fell to the tribe of Asher. The area included cities such as Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph, Allammelech, Amad and Mishal, and extended from Carmel in the west to great Sidon and the fortified city of Tyre – a total of twenty-two cities with their surrounding villages.
